name: QR Generator
description: Create QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi and contact cards instantly. Export PNG or SVG at high resolution — free, no sign-up, and everything runs in your browser.
longDescription: QR Generator lets you create professional QR codes in seconds. Customize colors, add logos, choose from multiple data types (URLs, vCard, WiFi, plain text, SMS, email). High-resolution PNG and SVG exports. Track scans with built-in analytics on paid plans.
pricingDetails: Free — no sign-up, no usage limit, no paid tier. Everything runs in your browser.
features: Multiple data types (URL, vCard, Wi-Fi, SMS, Email, text)
Custom colours and logo-free clean output
No sign-up, no scan limits, no paid tier
